title: PanIsoGuard benchmark result envelope
description: One committed, git-tracked metrics.json per benchmark protocol. The numeric claims that used to live only in README/validation prose live here, each stamped with how it was produced and how to reproduce it.

protocol.description: Protocol directory name under benchmark/ (e.g. controlled_truth, synthetic_axes, sqanti_sim).

scope.description: What input this result was computed on (e.g. ci_fixture, gencode_v49_chr22, hg002_giab_v4.2.1).

status.description: tracked = regenerated & byte-checkable by collect.py (self-contained); transcribed_pending_tracked_run = number copied from docs/validation.md, awaiting a committed tracked run (heavy external tooling); pending = not yet produced.

generated_utc.description: When this snapshot was produced; informational, ignored by `collect.py --check`.

data_provenance.description: Where the input came from, incl. accession/version for real data.

command.description: The exact command that regenerates this result.

source.description: For transcribed status: the doc/section the number was copied from.

metrics.description: Protocol-specific numeric results. Compared by `collect.py --check` for the self-contained protocols.
